title: Central Finland: 2.0 more lung cancer patients a year treated to cure, for €78,480 a year
markdown:
# Central Finland: 2.0 more lung cancer patients a year treated to cure, for €78,480 a year

> 2.0 more patients a year treated to cure · €78,480 of €1.00M · €921,520 left: nothing else pays off at these assumptions

## The gap

Of 100 lung cancer patients in Central Finland, 27 get treatment that aims to cure. In Finland it is 27. The difference is within what chance alone gives a county of this size. [^care_curative] Compared with the best quarter of counties, about 4.0 patients a year are missing from treatment that aims to cure (range 0.0 to 8.5). [^care_curative] [^model] Compared with Finland as a whole, there is no measured shortfall to divide between surgery and radiotherapy. [^model] More patients are operated here than in Finland: 22.4% against 14.9%. [^care_surgery]

## The target

Raise the share of lung cancer patients treated to cure from 27.2% to 28.7% by 2028: 2.0 more patients a year (range 0.0–2.0), for €78,480 a year, about €40,000 per extra patient. [^care_curative][^model]

## Funded actions

| # | Action and owner | Cost a year | More patients treated to cure a year (range) | First step this week | Measure: today → target |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| | **The county can start on Monday** | | | | |
| 1 | **Precise radiotherapy (SBRT) for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated**[^ev_sbrt_pathway_1]. Chief physician of oncology; chief of radiotherapy at the university hospital | €27,480 | 1.0 (0.0–2.0) | Write the referral rule: every stage I patient not accepted for surgery is referred for stereotactic radiotherapy the same week. | Share of patients who get treatment that aims to cure: 27.2% → 28.0% by 2028 |
| | **Needs the collaborative area (university hospital)** | | | | |
| 2 | **Weekly video review of every stage I-III patient with the university hospital's specialists**[^ev_video_mdt_stage1_3_1]. Chief physician of pulmonology; lead of the university hospital lung MDT | €51,000 | 1.0 (0.0–0.9) | Ask the university hospital for a fixed weekly video slot and list every stage I-III patient diagnosed last month who was not discussed there. | Share of patients who get treatment that aims to cure: 27.2% → 27.9% by 2028 |
| | **Total** | **€78,480** | **2.0 (0.0–2.0)** | | |

No trial has measured these effects; the low end of every range is zero. The ranges do not add up to the range of the total, because the measures share one ceiling. Costs are assumptions. [^model]

## Needs a national decision (outside this budget)

- **Low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers**[^ev_ldct_screening_1]: Ministry of Social Affairs and Health and Palko (decision), Finnish Cancer Registry (steering), county (delivery). €841,193 a year; modelled to avoid 1.5 deaths a year (0.3–3.8). Not counted in this budget. Not a county decision. Ask the Ministry and Palko for the timetable after the 2026-2028 pilot and offer the county as a pilot site. [^model]

## What to measure from Monday

- Share of patients treated to cure: 27.2% (2019–2023, measured) → 28.7% by 2028. [^care_curative][^model]
- The registry's public figures cover 2019–2023; count these each month from the county's own records. [^care_curative]

## What more money buys, and what it cannot

The remaining €921,520 buys nothing more in the model. [^model] The measures that widen access are limited by the reachable part of the measured shortfall, not by money. [^model] To see what else the money could do, look at low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers, which needs a national decision, or rank measures by deaths avoided instead. [^model] Lung cancer causes about 97 deaths a year in Central Finland, and this plan is modelled to avoid 0.3 of them (range 0.0 to 0.6). [^deaths] [^model]

## Limits

- Each effect range runs from lowest to highest value with all assumptions moved together. It is not a probability. No trial has measured these effects, so each could be zero. [^model]
- The expected share is adjusted only for residents' age. It is not adjusted for stage, fitness, histology, how the cancer was found, smoking or recording. County figures cannot show cause. [^model]
- The symptom-to-treatment clock is estimated, not measured, and is only a secondary view. In a check, 0 of 3 outcomes matched it beyond chance. [^model]

flagged.reason: Sentence carried a figure but no source marker; the supporting id is obvious (plan saturation note from the model), so [^model] was added.

flagged.reason: The material does not say these options would yield more; it only points to them as where to look for other uses of the money. Rewritten to match the source.

flagged.reason: The measured shares are not adjusted; only the expected share used for comparison is adjusted for the share of residents aged 65 or over. Rewritten so it is accurate.
